action_items: Remove/replace stale 'password admin123' demo hint on Login page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx:100) - it leaks default-credential info and is no longer valid post SEC-001.

server.py change-password endpoint does not enforce complexity (uppercase/digit/symbol) - only min length 8. Consider stronger policy for a health-data admin account.
Login page in Login.jsx still surfaces the old default password to any visitor - remove for production.

rca_of_the_issue: SEC-001 (already fixed by main agent): startup() previously re-hashed ADMIN_PASSWORD from env on every restart, negating password changes. Fix: startup only seeds if user is absent (server.py:854-865); new POST /api/auth/change-password (server.py:378-386) verifies old password, enforces min 8 chars, and updates users.password_hash. Verified: (1) restart does NOT reset password back to env value, (2) old admin123 returns 401, (3) UI flow works end-to-end, (4) all error branches (401/400 wrong-old, 400 min-length, 401 unauth) covered by tests.
